_comment: Fees are priced with the venue curves (schedule 2026-07-30, see docs/CROSS_VENUE_ARB.md). Add feesCents {kalshi, polymarket} in cents per share only to force a flat model; zero is ignored. kalshi.title and polymarket.question enable the question-type check. Each pair may carry a review object (docs/ARB_TAXONOMY.md, section 4): verdict pending, equivalent or not_equivalent, the seven-point checklist, a note and the source; only equivalent makes a pair hedged, and a pending draft counts as no review.
